about: Starting palettes and font pairings by kind of business, adapted from ui-ux-pro-max-skill by Next Level Builder (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 Next Level Builder, github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill). Colours are mapped to Kairoq design tokens (their Muted is used for secondary and muted surfaces).
